senses.en: a chemical or substance that produces a particular effect
senses.pattern: a cleaning agent / a chemical agent / a bleaching agent
senses.example: Bleach is a powerful cleaning [[agent]], so always wear gloves and open the windows when using it.
senses.example_zh: 漂白水是強效的清潔劑，所以使用時務必戴上手套並打開窗戶。

senses.en: a person or thing that causes a change
senses.pattern: an agent of change / an agent for change / agents of social change
senses.example: Teachers can be powerful [[agents]] of change in communities where few children finish school.
senses.example_zh: 在很少孩子能完成學業的社區裡，老師可以成為促成改變的重要推手。

senses.en: a skill developed through practice and study
senses.pattern: the art of conversation / the art of negotiation / master the art of
senses.example: It took the young reporter years to master the [[art]] of asking difficult questions politely.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕記者花了好幾年，才掌握禮貌地提出尖銳問題的技巧。

senses.en: subjects such as languages, history, and literature
senses.pattern: the arts and sciences / an arts student / a Bachelor of Arts
senses.example: She chose the sciences in senior high, while her twin brother preferred the [[arts]], especially history and literature.
senses.example_zh: 她高中選了理科，而她的雙胞胎哥哥偏好文科，尤其是歷史和文學。

gsat.sentence: But the culinary [[art]] of dim sum had yet to develop, for it was considered inappropriate to pair tea with food.
Despite the threats posed by cultural and political encroachment of colonial forces, the [[art]] of totem pole carving has survived.

senses.en: empty; not covered or decorated with anything
senses.pattern: bare shelves / bare walls / bare trees
senses.example: The walls of his new apartment were [[bare]] until he hung up some family photos.
senses.example_zh: 他新公寓的牆上原本空無一物，後來才掛上幾張家庭照片。

senses.en: the most basic; just enough and no more
senses.pattern: the bare essentials / the bare minimum / the bare necessities
senses.example: The hikers packed only the [[bare]] essentials: water, a map, a flashlight, and some dried food.
senses.example_zh: 登山客只帶了最基本的必需品：水、地圖、手電筒和一些乾糧。
senses.note: 動詞 bare＝露出，如 bare its teeth

gsat.sentence: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost [[bare]] and the stock nearly gone.
But now the garden looked shabby and [[bare]].

senses.en: a large solid piece of hard material
senses.pattern: a block of ice / a block of wood / concrete blocks
senses.example: The artist spent three weeks carving a huge [[block]] of marble into a sleeping lion.
senses.example_zh: 這位藝術家花了三週，把一大塊大理石雕成一頭沉睡的獅子。

senses.en: something that stops progress or clear thinking
senses.pattern: a mental block / a stumbling block / a block to progress
senses.example: Fear of making mistakes can be a major stumbling [[block]] for anyone learning to speak a foreign language.
senses.example_zh: 害怕犯錯，可能是任何人學說外語時的一大障礙。

gsat.sentence: Larger [[blocks]] of ice from Sweden are easier to handle for sculptors.
These large ice [[blocks]] are used for large ice sculpting events and for building ice hotels.

senses.en: a public demand or request for something to happen
senses.pattern: calls for reform / a call for help / a call to action
senses.example: After the accident, parents made repeated [[calls]] for stricter safety checks on school buses.
senses.example_zh: 事故發生後，家長一再呼籲對校車進行更嚴格的安全檢查。
senses.note: 動詞片語 call for＝呼籲；需要

senses.en: to announce that a meeting, election, or strike will happen
senses.pattern: call a meeting / call an election / call a strike
senses.example: The principal [[called]] an urgent meeting to discuss how to keep students safe during the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 校長召開緊急會議，討論颱風期間如何確保學生安全。

gsat.sentence: The recent cooking oil scandals have led to [[calls]] for tougher regulation of sales of food products.

senses.en: to get off one vehicle and board another
senses.pattern: change trains / change planes / change buses
senses.example: There is no direct service to the coast, so you will have to [[change]] trains at the next station.
senses.example_zh: 沒有直達海岸的班車，所以你得在下一站轉乘另一班火車。

senses.en: to exchange money for another currency or smaller units
senses.pattern: change money / change dollars into yen / change a bill
senses.example: Before flying to Tokyo, Kevin went to the bank to [[change]] some dollars into Japanese yen.
senses.example_zh: 飛往東京前，凱文到銀行把一些美元兌換成日圓。

senses.en: to cover something with a thin layer
senses.pattern: coat A with B / be coated with / be coated in
senses.example: Workers [[coated]] the wooden bridge with a special oil to protect it from the rain.
senses.example_zh: 工人在木橋上塗上一層特殊的油，以防雨水侵蝕。

senses.en: a layer of paint or another substance on a surface
senses.pattern: a coat of paint / a fresh coat / a second coat
senses.example: The old classroom looked much brighter after the students gave the walls a fresh [[coat]] of paint.
senses.example_zh: 學生替牆壁刷上一層新油漆後，舊教室看起來明亮多了。
senses.note: 名詞 coating 也指塗層、覆蓋層

senses.en: the fur or hair covering an animal's body
senses.pattern: a thick coat / a shiny coat / shed its coat
senses.example: The mountain goat grows a thick white [[coat]] that keeps it warm through the freezing winter.
senses.example_zh: 這種山羊會長出厚厚的白色皮毛，讓牠在嚴冬中保暖。

gsat.sentence: Researchers found that commercial popcorn companies often [[coat]] their microwave popcorn bags with a chemical called perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) which has been found to cause both cancer and lung disease in laboratory animals.
He then [[coated]] the glue on a paper sample and found that it was not only a good bookmark, but it was great for writing notes.

senses.en: to be about or to involve someone or something
senses.pattern: concern sb / as far as … is concerned / to whom it may concern
senses.example: The new rule [[concerns]] only students who ride motorcycles to school, not those who take the bus.
senses.example_zh: 這項新規定只與騎機車上學的學生有關，與搭公車的學生無關。
senses.note: as far as … is concerned＝就…而言

senses.en: a business or company
senses.pattern: a family concern / a business concern / a going concern
senses.example: What began as a small family [[concern]] selling noodles now has forty restaurants across the country.
senses.example_zh: 當初只是賣麵的小型家族企業，如今在全國已有四十家餐廳。

gsat.sentence: However, if we travel west we will be in advance of ourselves as far as our internal clock is [[concerned]], and problems may arise.
They often [[concern]] very strong or clever people who come from humble backgrounds.

senses.en: to make someone lose something valuable
senses.pattern: cost sb their life / cost sb the job / cost sb the game
senses.example: Arriving twenty minutes late for the final interview [[cost]] Jason the job he had always wanted.
senses.example_zh: 最後一輪面試遲到二十分鐘，使傑森失去了他夢寐以求的工作。

senses.en: the loss or harm suffered in order to gain something
senses.pattern: at the cost of / at all costs / at great cost
senses.example: The factory increased its profits, but only at the [[cost]] of the health of nearby residents.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠增加了獲利，卻是以附近居民的健康為代價。

gsat.sentence: They had to learn from their own mistakes, which [[cost]] some their lives, and almost all suffered light or severe injuries.
Still, many animal rights activists believe the [[cost]] of confining animals outweighs the benefits.

senses.en: to become clear to someone after a while
senses.pattern: dawn on sb / it dawned on me that / the truth dawned
senses.example: Only when the bill arrived did it [[dawn]] on us how expensive the restaurant really was.
senses.example_zh: 直到帳單送來，我們才恍然大悟，這家餐廳原來這麼貴。
senses.note: 常用句型 It dawned on sb that…

senses.en: the beginning of a new period or development
senses.pattern: the dawn of civilization / the dawn of a new era / since the dawn of time
senses.example: The invention of the printing press marked the [[dawn]] of a new age of learning in Europe.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明，代表歐洲求知新時代的開端。

senses.en: to be enough or good enough for a purpose
senses.pattern: will do / that will do / won't do
senses.example: We have no proper vase, but this empty glass jar will [[do]] for the flowers.
senses.example_zh: 我們沒有像樣的花瓶，不過這個空玻璃罐拿來插花就夠用了。

gsat.sentence: Then the child has to make [[do]] with shoes that are too small.

senses.en: a slight advantage over other people
senses.pattern: a competitive edge / have an edge over / give sb an edge
senses.example: The company hopes its longer-lasting battery will give it an [[edge]] in the crowded electric scooter market.
senses.example_zh: 該公司希望續航力更長的電池，能讓它在競爭激烈的電動機車市場中取得優勢。

senses.en: to move slowly and carefully in one direction
senses.pattern: edge toward / edge closer / edge forward / edge one's way
senses.example: The frightened kitten slowly [[edged]] toward the bowl of milk, watching us the whole time.
senses.example_zh: 受驚的小貓朝那碗牛奶慢慢挪動，眼睛始終盯著我們。

gsat.sentence: In this way, these secret shoppers may help a business gain a competitive [[edge]].

senses.en: to require someone to do something as a duty
senses.pattern: be expected to do / expect sb to do / expect sth from sb
senses.example: At this school, all students are [[expected]] to clean their own classrooms before going home.
senses.example_zh: 在這所學校，所有學生都被要求在放學回家前打掃自己的教室。

senses.en: to be going to have a baby
senses.pattern: be expecting / be expecting a baby / be expecting twins
senses.example: My aunt is [[expecting]] her second baby in June, so we are already shopping for tiny clothes.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨懷孕了，第二胎預計六月出生，所以我們已經開始買嬰兒服。
senses.note: 此義只用進行式 be expecting

gsat.sentence: “You [[expect]] us to play seven days a week for merely five rupees!” they yelled.

senses.en: the way something feels when you touch it
senses.pattern: the feel of / a soft feel / a smooth feel
senses.example: I love the [[feel]] of this old wool blanket; it is far softer than any new one.
senses.example_zh: 我很喜歡這條舊羊毛毯的觸感，它比任何新毯子都柔軟得多。

senses.en: the atmosphere or general character of a place
senses.pattern: a friendly feel / a modern feel / have the feel of
senses.example: With its wooden tables and soft lighting, the café has the cozy [[feel]] of a family kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館有木桌和柔和的燈光，散發出家庭廚房般的溫馨氛圍。

senses.en: to search for something using your hands
senses.pattern: feel for / feel around for / feel in one's pocket
senses.example: When the lights went out, Dad [[felt]] along the wall for the switch of the emergency lamp.
senses.example_zh: 停電時，爸爸沿著牆壁摸索緊急照明燈的開關。
senses.note: 過去式 felt；feel for＝摸索尋找

gsat.sentence: The [[feel]] of a book, the smell, the weight, and the knowledge that a particular book might be more than a hundred years old—all these highlight the importance of preserving the physical book as a complement to technology.

senses.zh: 有影響力的人或事物；勢力
senses.en: a person or thing that has great influence
senses.pattern: a driving force / a powerful force / a force for good
senses.example: Social media has become a powerful [[force]] in shaping what young people buy and wear.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體已成為一股強大的勢力，影響著年輕人的購買與穿著。

senses.en: an organized group of soldiers or police
senses.pattern: the armed forces / the police force / security forces
senses.example: Peacekeeping [[forces]] were sent to the border to protect villagers fleeing the fighting.
senses.example_zh: 維和部隊被派往邊境，保護逃離戰火的村民。

gsat.sentence: Trade is certainly a main driving [[force]] for globalization.
The [[forces]] that are crushing individual lives and futures are also destroying the prospects for an entire region.

senses.en: a natural ability or talent
senses.pattern: a gift for languages / have a gift for / a natural gift
senses.example: Even as a child, Lily had a rare [[gift]] for making strangers feel comfortable around her.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉從小就有一種難得的天賦，能讓陌生人在她身邊感到自在。

senses.en: to affect a person or place very badly
senses.pattern: be hit by / be hard hit / be badly hit
senses.example: The small fishing village was badly [[hit]] by the storm, and dozens of boats were destroyed.
senses.example_zh: 這個小漁村遭暴風雨重創，數十艘船被毀。

senses.en: to reach a particular level or number
senses.pattern: hit a record high / hit a new low / hit 40 degrees
senses.example: Temperatures in the desert city [[hit]] 45 degrees last week, the highest level in a century.
senses.example_zh: 這座沙漠城市的氣溫上週達到四十五度，是百年來的最高紀錄。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following is a reason why Dallas was [[hit]] most seriously in the U.S. in 2012?
The island continues to recover from its 1992 visit from Iniki, the most powerful hurricane to [[hit]] Hawaii this century.

senses.en: to bring a system, law, or product into use
senses.pattern: introduce a system / introduce a law / introduce changes
senses.example: The city plans to [[introduce]] a new recycling system that rewards families for sorting their trash.
senses.example_zh: 該市計畫推行一套新的回收制度，獎勵確實做好垃圾分類的家庭。

senses.en: to bring a plant, animal, or thing to a new place
senses.pattern: be introduced to / be introduced into / be introduced from
senses.example: Rabbits were [[introduced]] to the island by sailors and soon ate most of the native plants.
senses.example_zh: 兔子由水手引進這座島，很快就吃掉了大部分的原生植物。

gsat.sentence: Recently, new models have been [[introduced]] and accessories added to meet the needs of laborers working on various job sites.
The liquid was originally a grape alcohol [[introduced]] from France in the late 14th century.

senses.en: thin and fit; (of meat) containing little fat
senses.pattern: lean meat / a lean body / lean and fit
senses.example: Years of long-distance running had given the old farmer a [[lean]], strong body.
senses.example_zh: 多年的長跑讓這位老農夫擁有精瘦而結實的身材。

senses.en: (of a period) difficult, with little money or food
senses.pattern: lean years / lean times / a lean season
senses.example: During the [[lean]] years after the factory closed, many families in town could barely pay their rent.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉後那幾年不景氣，鎮上許多家庭幾乎付不出房租。

senses.en: to be careful about something
senses.pattern: mind your step / mind your head / mind your manners
senses.example: [[Mind]] the wet floor near the entrance; someone slipped there just a few minutes ago.
senses.example_zh: 當心入口附近濕滑的地板，幾分鐘前才有人在那裡滑倒。
senses.note: 多用於祈使句，如 Mind your step.

senses.en: a very intelligent person
senses.pattern: the brightest minds / great minds / one of the finest minds
senses.example: The conference brought together some of the brightest [[minds]] in medicine to fight the new disease.
senses.example_zh: 這場會議匯集了醫學界一些最聰明的人才，共同對抗這種新疾病。

senses.en: the basic character or qualities of something
senses.pattern: the nature of the problem / by nature / similar in nature
senses.example: Because of the dangerous [[nature]] of the job, firefighters must train for months before their first mission.
senses.example_zh: 由於這份工作具有危險的性質，消防員首次出任務前必須受訓數月。

senses.en: the character a person or animal is born with
senses.pattern: human nature / a gentle nature / it is not in sb's nature to
senses.example: It is not in her [[nature]] to give up, even when everyone else thinks the task is impossible.
senses.example_zh: 輕言放棄不是她的天性，即使其他人都認為這項任務不可能完成。

gsat.sentence: Racist remarks are by [[nature]] offensive and hurtful, and should be avoided on all occasions.

French psychologist Alfred Binet (1859-1911) took a different approach from most other psychologists of his day: He was interested in the workings of the normal mind rather than the [[nature]] of mental illness.

senses.en: but; except that
senses.pattern: the same, only bigger / only it's too expensive / only I can't
senses.example: This phone looks just like mine, [[only]] the screen is slightly bigger and the case is blue.
senses.example_zh: 這支手機看起來跟我的一模一樣，只是螢幕稍大，而且外殼是藍色的。

senses.en: used to introduce a surprising or disappointing result
senses.pattern: only to find / only to discover / only to be told
senses.example: He ran all the way to the station, [[only]] to learn that the last train had left.
senses.example_zh: 他一路跑到車站，結果卻得知末班車已經開走了。
senses.note: only to + 原形動詞，表意外結果

gsat.sentence: White rhinoceroses, it turns out, do the same thing—[[only]] their choice of meeting place is a giant pile of poop.
Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—[[only]] to find the shelves almost bare and the stock nearly gone.

senses.en: a piece of academic writing on a subject
senses.pattern: a term paper / a research paper / publish a paper
senses.example: Professor Lin's latest [[paper]] on sleep and memory was published in a leading medical journal.
senses.example_zh: 林教授關於睡眠與記憶的最新論文，發表在一份頂尖的醫學期刊上。

senses.en: official documents, especially ones proving identity
senses.pattern: identity papers / show one's papers / sign the papers
senses.example: The officer at the border asked the driver to show his [[papers]] before letting the truck pass.
senses.example_zh: 邊境的官員要求司機出示證件，才讓卡車通過。

gsat.sentence: Writing term [[papers]] and giving oral reports are typical course requirements for college students.
I’m working on my history [[paper]].

senses.en: to hold someone or something so it cannot move
senses.pattern: pin sb to the ground / be pinned under / pin sb against the wall
senses.example: The wrestler [[pinned]] his opponent to the mat for three seconds and won the gold medal.
senses.example_zh: 這位摔角選手把對手壓在墊上三秒，使他動彈不得，贏得金牌。

senses.en: to depend on something completely for hope or success
senses.pattern: pin one's hopes on / pin one's faith on / pin everything on
senses.example: The villagers have [[pinned]] their hopes on the new bridge to bring more visitors to the area.
senses.example_zh: 村民把希望寄託於這座新橋，期盼它為當地帶來更多遊客。
senses.note: pin the blame on＝把過錯歸咎於

senses.en: to move somewhere quickly in large numbers
senses.pattern: pour into / pour out of / pour in
senses.example: As soon as the gates opened, thousands of excited fans [[poured]] into the stadium for the final.
senses.example_zh: 大門一開，成千上萬名興奮的球迷便湧入體育場觀看決賽。

senses.en: to rain very heavily
senses.pattern: it is pouring / pour down / pour with rain
senses.example: It was [[pouring]] when the game ended, and nobody in our group had brought an umbrella.
senses.example_zh: 比賽結束時正下著傾盆大雨，而我們這群人都沒帶傘。
senses.note: 主詞常用 it，多用進行式

gsat.sentence: Unfortunately, it started [[pouring]].

senses.en: to declare something officially or formally
senses.pattern: pronounce sb dead / pronounce sb fit / pronounce sb husband and wife
senses.example: After a careful examination, the vet [[pronounced]] the injured eagle healthy enough to be released.
senses.example_zh: 仔細檢查後，獸醫宣布這隻受傷的老鷹已經健康到可以野放了。

senses.en: very noticeable or obvious
senses.pattern: a pronounced effect / a pronounced difference / become more pronounced
senses.example: The difference between the two groups was most [[pronounced]] among students who slept under six hours.
senses.example_zh: 兩組之間的差異，在睡眠不足六小時的學生當中最為顯著。
senses.note: 由過去分詞轉成的形容詞 pronounced

gsat.sentence: Early this past summer the three whales were [[pronounced]] fit enough to be returned to the Atlantic Ocean.

senses.en: to think logically and reach a conclusion
senses.pattern: reason that / reason logically / the ability to reason
senses.example: The detective [[reasoned]] that the thief must have had a key, since no window was broken.
senses.example_zh: 偵探推論小偷一定有鑰匙，因為沒有任何一扇窗戶被打破。

senses.en: the ability to think and judge sensibly
senses.pattern: listen to reason / lose one's reason / within reason
senses.example: Fear can be stronger than [[reason]], which is why people panic even when they know they are safe.
senses.example_zh: 恐懼有時比理智更強大，這就是為什麼人們明知安全仍會驚慌。

gsat.sentence: Dognition’s test measures a dog’s intellect in several aspects—from empathy to memory to [[reasoning]] skills.

senses.en: being the cause of something, especially something bad
senses.pattern: be responsible for / be largely responsible for / be partly responsible for
senses.example: Scientists believe that a tiny insect is [[responsible]] for the sudden death of thousands of pine trees.
senses.example_zh: 科學家認為，一種小昆蟲是造成數千棵松樹突然死亡的原因。

gsat.sentence: This substance, according to health scientists, is [[responsible]] for some serious lung diseases.
Their simple design is [[responsible]] for many foot injuries.

senses.en: to meet a requirement, condition, or standard
senses.pattern: satisfy a requirement / satisfy the conditions / satisfy the criteria
senses.example: The new playground cannot open until it [[satisfies]] every safety standard set by the city government.
senses.example_zh: 新遊樂場必須符合市政府訂定的每一項安全標準，才能開放。

senses.en: to make someone certain that something is true
senses.pattern: satisfy sb that / satisfy oneself that / be satisfied that
senses.example: The inspector checked every room to [[satisfy]] herself that the building was safe for children.
senses.example_zh: 檢查員查看了每個房間，好使自己確信這棟建築對兒童是安全的。

senses.en: needing to be kept secret or handled carefully
senses.pattern: sensitive information / sensitive data / a sensitive issue
senses.example: Never send [[sensitive]] information such as passwords or bank details over a public wireless network.
senses.example_zh: 切勿透過公共無線網路傳送密碼或銀行資料等機密資訊。

senses.en: understanding and caring about other people's feelings
senses.pattern: be sensitive to sb's needs / a sensitive listener / caring and sensitive
senses.example: A good nurse is [[sensitive]] to patients' fears and takes time to explain each treatment.
senses.example_zh: 好的護理師會體貼病人的恐懼，並花時間說明每一項治療。

gsat.sentence: Fostering empathy…By seeing an animal up close, the public could be encouraged to be more [[sensitive]] and compassionate to a species that is facing extinction in the wild.

senses.en: to make someone stop speaking or criticizing
senses.pattern: silence the crowd / silence one's critics / silence opposition
senses.example: The teacher [[silenced]] the noisy class with a single look and then continued the lesson.
senses.example_zh: 老師只用一個眼神就使吵鬧的全班安靜下來，然後繼續上課。

gsat.sentence: wanted to [[silence]] a complaining diner

senses.en: a person, especially in negative statements
senses.pattern: not a soul / not tell a soul / a kind soul
senses.example: At six in the morning there was not a [[soul]] on the beach except one old fisherman.
senses.example_zh: 清晨六點，海灘上除了一位老漁夫之外，一個人也沒有。

gsat.sentence: I didn’t know a [[soul]] in the city.

senses.en: to say or write something formally and clearly
senses.pattern: state that / state clearly / as stated above
senses.example: In her letter, the scientist [[stated]] that the experiment had been repeated five times with the same results.
senses.example_zh: 這位科學家在信中聲明，該實驗已重複五次，結果都相同。

senses.en: a country or its government
senses.pattern: a member state / heads of state / be run by the state
senses.example: In many countries, basic education is paid for by the [[state]] rather than by parents.
senses.example_zh: 在許多國家，基礎教育的費用是由國家而非家長負擔。

gsat.sentence: Owner Joseph Tang says he knew the idea would work well in this unique district: “Each store is one of a kind in Wonder Village,” he [[states]].
The Russian [[state]] played a significant role in the spread of alcohol consumption in the country.

senses.en: to move your hand gently over something
senses.pattern: stroke a cat / stroke sb's hair / stroke gently
senses.example: The little girl gently [[stroked]] the rabbit's ears until it fell asleep in her arms.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩輕輕撫摸兔子的耳朵，直到牠在她懷裡睡著。

senses.en: a single hit, or movement of a pen or brush
senses.pattern: brush strokes / a stroke of the pen / with one stroke
senses.example: With a few quick [[strokes]] of his brush, the painter turned a blank sheet into a mountain scene.
senses.example_zh: 畫家用畫筆快速揮了幾筆，就把一張白紙變成一幅山景。

senses.en: a sudden piece of luck or a clever idea
senses.pattern: a stroke of luck / a stroke of genius / a stroke of fortune
senses.example: By a [[stroke]] of luck, two tickets for the sold-out concert were returned just as we reached the box office.
senses.example_zh: 好運突然降臨：我們剛到售票口，正好有人退回兩張原本已售完的演唱會門票。
senses.note: a stroke of luck＝意外的好運

gsat.sentence: After that sow gives birth, find the fourth piglet with a mark on its brow and, with one [[stroke]] of your knife, slaughter it.

senses.en: to follow someone closely and secretly
senses.pattern: tail a suspect / tail a car / be tailed by
senses.example: Two detectives [[tailed]] the suspect's car across the city without being noticed once.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警探跟蹤嫌犯的車穿越整座城市，一次也沒被發現。

senses.en: the side of a coin without a head on it
senses.pattern: heads or tails / call tails / come up tails
senses.example: The captain called [[tails]], the coin landed on heads, and the other team got to kick first.
senses.example_zh: 隊長猜反面，結果硬幣是正面朝上，於是由另一隊先開球。
senses.note: 用複數 tails；正面為 heads

senses.en: a mass of similar cells forming part of a body
senses.pattern: muscle tissue / brain tissue / damaged tissue / scar tissue
senses.example: Regular exercise helps the body build muscle [[tissue]] and repair cells damaged during the day.
senses.example_zh: 規律運動有助於身體增生肌肉組織，並修復白天受損的細胞。

gsat.sentence: Most of them act as cleaners for other fish and pick dead [[tissue]] from their bodies.

senses.en: to adjust an instrument or engine so it works correctly
senses.pattern: tune a guitar / tune a piano / tune an engine
senses.example: Before every concert, the violinist spends ten minutes carefully [[tuning]] her instrument backstage.
senses.example_zh: 每場音樂會前，這位小提琴家都會在後台花十分鐘仔細替樂器調音。

senses.en: by a large amount or distance; far
senses.pattern: way too much / way ahead / way behind / way more
senses.example: Ticket prices this year are [[way]] higher than last year, so fewer families are going to the festival.
senses.example_zh: 今年的票價遠遠高於去年，所以去參加慶典的家庭變少了。

senses.en: a particular aspect or point of something
senses.pattern: in many ways / in some ways / in every way
senses.example: In many [[ways]], life in a small town is healthier than life in a crowded city.
senses.example_zh: 在許多方面，小鎮的生活比擁擠城市的生活更健康。

senses.en: to take back something you offered or said
senses.pattern: withdraw an offer / withdraw a remark / withdraw support / withdraw a complaint
senses.example: The company [[withdrew]] its job offer after discovering that he had lied about his degree.
senses.example_zh: 公司發現他謊報學歷後，撤回了這份工作邀約。

senses.en: to stop taking part in something; to move back
senses.pattern: withdraw from a competition / withdraw from the race / withdraw from the talks / withdraw from the city
senses.example: A knee injury forced her to [[withdraw]] from the tournament the day before the final.
senses.example_zh: 膝傷迫使她在決賽前一天退出這項錦標賽。

senses.en: the babies of an animal
senses.pattern: feed their young / protect its young / raise their young
senses.example: A mother bear will attack anything that comes between her and her [[young]].
senses.example_zh: 母熊會攻擊任何擋在牠和幼熊之間的東西。
senses.note: 集合名詞，視為複數，不加 -s

quiz.stem: Students who read widely in English tend to have a clear ______ over their classmates when it comes to writing essays.
quiz.explain_zh: edge＝優勢。廣泛閱讀英文的學生寫作文時比同學更占優勢。

quiz.stem: After the earthquake, rescuers worked for six hours to free a man whose legs were ______ under a fallen concrete wall.
quiz.explain_zh: pin＝壓住、使動彈不得。男子雙腿被倒塌的水泥牆壓住，救難人員花六小時才救出他。

quiz.stem: Health officials are still trying to find out which dish was ______ for making more than fifty wedding guests sick.
quiz.explain_zh: responsible＝是…的原因。衛生官員仍在追查是哪道菜造成五十多位賓客身體不適。

quiz.stem: The death of thousands of fish in the river has prompted growing ______ for the factory upstream to be shut down.
quiz.explain_zh: call＝呼籲、要求。河中大量魚群死亡，要求關閉上游工廠的呼聲越來越高。

quiz.stem: Halfway through the exam, it suddenly ______ on Kevin that he had been writing his answers in the wrong section of the answer sheet.
quiz.explain_zh: dawn＝（使人）恍然大悟。凱文考到一半才猛然發現，自己把答案寫在錯誤的作答區。

quiz.stem: To help his players stay in shape, the coach told them to choose ______ meat such as chicken breast and to avoid anything fried or fatty.
quiz.explain_zh: lean＝（肉）瘦的。教練要球員選雞胸肉之類的瘦肉，避開油炸或高脂食物。

quiz.stem: Only applicants who ______ all the requirements listed on the website, including having a valid driver's license, will be invited to an interview.
quiz.explain_zh: satisfy＝符合（條件）。只有符合網站所列全部條件的應徵者才會受邀面試。

quiz.stem: The burn was so serious that doctors had to remove the damaged ______ and cover the wound with healthy skin from the patient's leg.
quiz.explain_zh: tissue＝（生物）組織。燒傷嚴重，醫生必須切除受損組織，再用腿部的健康皮膚覆蓋傷口。

quiz.stem: A single moment of carelessness on the icy mountain road nearly ______ the young truck driver his life.
quiz.explain_zh: cost＝使失去。在結冰山路上一時疏忽，差點讓年輕的卡車司機喪命。

quiz.stem: It was a real ______ of luck that a doctor happened to be sitting next to the passenger who suddenly fainted on the plane.
quiz.explain_zh: stroke＝（好運的）突然降臨。昏倒的乘客旁邊剛好坐著醫生，真是意外的好運。
